commits.message:
[AMD] Make release atomics cover writes from every warp (#12657)

A scalar or warp-redundant atomic is issued by one thread after a CTA
barrier, and its release fence lowers to waits on the issuing wave's own
counters. On AMD, `s_barrier` waits on no memory counter, and the
workgroup fences around it don't wait for global writes either, since
waves of a workgroup see them through a shared L1 (or L0 in CU mode). So
writes another wave issued before the barrier can still be in flight
when the atomic goes out. On gfx942/gfx950 the release's L2 writeback
(`buffer_wbl2`) can then miss them, and a consumer on another XCD that
acquires the atomic reads stale data:

```
wave 1:  store ─(in flight)────────────────────────────► reaches L2 late
wave 0:  store  s_barrier  buffer_wbl2  s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)  atomic
```

gfx1250 has the same shape with `global_wb`. This breaks the common
"every warp writes partials, one thread bumps a counter" pattern, for
example split-KV attention that merges in the last split, which today
needs an inline-asm `s_waitcnt` to be correct.

Have every thread release its own writes before the leading barrier, so
the barrier orders all of them before the atomic:

- `insertAtomicOrderingBarriers` takes the atomic's scope and, for a
`release` or `acq_rel` atomic with more than one warp or CTA, calls the
new `TargetInfoBase::releaseBeforeAtomicBarrier` hook before the
barrier. The hook is a no-op by default; NVIDIA needs nothing since
`bar.sync` plus a scoped fence is cumulative.
- AMD skips `cta` scope, which the barrier already covers. Each wave
only waits for its own stores: `s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)` on CDNA2/3/4 and
`s_wait_storecnt 0` on gfx1250. The atomic's own release after the
barrier then writes back L2 once for all waves. Other targets emit a
global-only release `llvm.fence` at the atomic's scope and let LLVM
choose the waits; on RDNA4 it folds into the store wait the barrier
already has.

+// RUN: triton-opt %s -split-input-file --allocate-shared-memory --triton-amdgpu-membar='gfx-arch=gfx950' --convert-triton-amdgpu-to-llvm=gfx-arch=gfx950 | FileCheck %s --enable-var-scope --check-prefixes=GFX950,GFX9,COMMON
 // RUN: triton-opt %s -split-input-file --allocate-shared-memory --triton-amdgpu-membar='gfx-arch=gfx1250' --convert-triton-amdgpu-to-llvm=gfx-arch=gfx1250 | FileCheck %s --enable-var-scope --check-prefixes=GFX1250,COMMON
 
 // COMMON-DAG: [[$LOCAL_MMRA_TAG:#[A-Za-z0-9_]+]] = #llvm.mmra_tag<"amdgpu-synchronize-as":"local">
@@ -79,6 +79,55 @@ module attributes {"ttg.num-ctas" = 1 : i32, "ttg.num-warps" = 4 : i32} {
 
 // -----
 
+// COMMON-DAG: [[$REL_LOCAL:#[A-Za-z0-9_]+]] = #llvm.mmra_tag<"amdgpu-synchronize-as":"local">
+module attributes {"ttg.num-ctas" = 1 : i32, "ttg.num-warps" = 4 : i32, "ttg.threads-per-warp" = 64 : i32} {
+  // COMMON-LABEL: @atomic_release_scalar_multi_wave
+  tt.func @atomic_release_scalar_multi_wave(%ptr: !tt.ptr<i32>, %val: i32) {
+    // GFX9: rocdl.s.waitcnt 3952
+    // GFX1250: rocdl.s.wait.storecnt 0
+    // COMMON-NEXT: llvm.fence syncscope("workgroup") release {llvm.mmra = [[$REL_LOCAL]]}
+    // COMMON-NEXT: rocdl.s.barrier
+    // COMMON: llvm.atomicrmw add {{.*}} syncscope("agent") release
+    %0 = tt.atomic_rmw add, release, gpu, %ptr, %val : (!tt.ptr<i32>, i32) -> i32
+    // GFX9: rocdl.s.waitcnt 3952
+    // GFX1250: rocdl.s.wait.storecnt 0
+    // COMMON-NEXT: llvm.fence syncscope("workgroup") release {llvm.mmra = [[$REL_LOCAL]]}
+    // COMMON-NEXT: rocdl.s.barrier
+    // COMMON: llvm.atomicrmw add {{.*}} syncscope("agent") acq_rel
+    %1 = tt.atomic_rmw add, acq_rel, gpu, %ptr, %val : (!tt.ptr<i32>, i32) -> i32
+    // GFX9: rocdl.s.waitcnt 3952
+    // GFX1250: rocdl.s.wait.storecnt 0
+    // COMMON-NEXT: llvm.fence syncscope("workgroup") release {llvm.mmra = [[$REL_LOCAL]]}
+    // COMMON-NEXT: rocdl.s.barrier
+    // COMMON: llvm.atomicrmw add {{.*}} release
+    %2 = tt.atomic_rmw add, release, sys, %ptr, %val : (!tt.ptr<i32>, i32) -> i32
+    // The CTA barrier already orders writes for a workgroup-scope release.
+    // GFX9-NOT: rocdl.s.waitcnt
+    // GFX1250-NOT: rocdl.s.wait.storecnt
+    // COMMON: llvm.atomicrmw add {{.*}} syncscope("workgroup") release
+    %3 = tt.atomic_rmw add, release, cta, %ptr, %val : (!tt.ptr<i32>, i32) -> i32
+    // COMMON: llvm.return
+    tt.return
+  }
+}
+
+// -----
+
+module attributes {"ttg.num-ctas" = 1 : i32, "ttg.num-warps" = 1 : i32, "ttg.threads-per-warp" = 64 : i32} {
+  // COMMON-LABEL: @atomic_release_scalar_single_wave
+  tt.func @atomic_release_scalar_single_wave(%ptr: !tt.ptr<i32>, %val: i32) {
+    // One wave's writes are covered by the atomic's own release.
+    // GFX9-NOT: rocdl.s.waitcnt
+    // GFX1250-NOT: rocdl.s.wait.storecnt
+    // COMMON: llvm.atomicrmw add {{.*}} syncscope("agent") release
+    %0 = tt.atomic_rmw add, release, gpu, %ptr, %val : (!tt.ptr<i32>, i32) -> i32
+    // COMMON: llvm.return
+    tt.return
+  }
+}

+// RUN: triton-opt %s -split-input-file --allocate-shared-memory --convert-triton-amdgpu-to-llvm=gfx-arch=gfx1200 --convert-builtin-func-to-llvm | FileCheck %s --check-prefix=GFX12
 
 #blocked3 = #ttg.blocked<{sizePerThread = [1], threadsPerWarp = [32], warpsPerCTA = [1], order = [0]}>
 module attributes {"ttg.num-ctas" = 1 : i32, "ttg.num-warps" = 1 : i32, "ttg.threads-per-warp" = 32 : i32} {
@@ -76,3 +77,37 @@ tt.func private @bf16_mulf(%arg0: tensor<64xbf16, #blocked>, %arg1: tensor<64xbf
   tt.return %0 : tensor<64xbf16, #blocked>
 }
 }
+
+// -----
+
+// GFX11-DAG: [[$REL_GLOBAL:#[A-Za-z0-9_]+]] = #llvm.mmra_tag<"amdgpu-synchronize-as":"global">
+module attributes {"ttg.num-ctas" = 1 : i32, "ttg.num-warps" = 4 : i32, "ttg.threads-per-warp" = 32 : i32} {
+  // GFX11-LABEL: @atomic_release_scalar_multi_wave
+  // GFX12-LABEL: @atomic_release_scalar_multi_wave
+  tt.func @atomic_release_scalar_multi_wave(%ptr: !tt.ptr<i32>, %val: i32) {
+    // GFX11: llvm.fence syncscope("agent") release {llvm.mmra = [[$REL_GLOBAL]]}
+    // GFX11-NEXT: llvm.fence syncscope("workgroup") release
+    // GFX11-NEXT: rocdl.s.barrier
+    // GFX11: llvm.atomicrmw add {{.*}} syncscope("agent") release
+    // GFX12: rocdl.s.wait.storecnt 0
+    // GFX12-NEXT: llvm.fence syncscope("workgroup") release
+    // GFX12-NEXT: rocdl.s.barrier.signal
+    // GFX12: llvm.atomicrmw add {{.*}} syncscope("agent") release
+    %0 = tt.atomic_rmw add, release, gpu, %ptr, %val : (!tt.ptr<i32>, i32) -> i32
+    // The system-scope release does not repeat global_wb in every wave on
+    // gfx12; the atomic's own release writes back once.
+    // GFX11: llvm.fence syncscope("agent") release {llvm.mmra = [[$REL_GLOBAL]]}
+    // GFX11-NEXT: llvm.fence syncscope("workgroup") release
+    // GFX11: llvm.atomicrmw add {{.*}} release
+    // GFX12: rocdl.s.wait.storecnt 0
+    // GFX12-NEXT: llvm.fence syncscope("workgroup") release
+    // GFX12: llvm.atomicrmw add {{.*}} release
+    %1 = tt.atomic_rmw add, release, sys, %ptr, %val : (!tt.ptr<i32>, i32) -> i32
+    // GFX11-NOT: llvm.fence syncscope("agent")
+    // GFX12-NOT: rocdl.s.wait.storecnt
+    // GFX11: llvm.atomicrmw add {{.*}} syncscope("workgroup") release
+    // GFX12: llvm.atomicrmw add {{.*}} syncscope("workgroup") release
+    %2 = tt.atomic_rmw add, release, cta, %ptr, %val : (!tt.ptr<i32>, i32) -> i32
+    tt.return
+  }
+}
